$schema_note: Branch-level patch matrix for PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619). The patch checker reads this file. Update fixed_build as PHP ships new patch releases on each branch; this snapshot is current as of the advisory date.

advisory.name: PHP2Shell
advisory.class: CWE-824 (Access of Uninitialized Pointer) / unauthenticated RCE + memory disclosure
advisory.note: Memory-safety failures in the PHP engine. Every release since 5.4 is affected; application quality is not a mitigation. Distribution and LTS vendors may backport the fix WITHOUT bumping to the upstream fixed build number - always confirm a distro-packaged PHP against your vendor's advisory, not the upstream version string alone.

safe.label: SAFE
safe.meaning: At or above the fixed build on a supported branch. Confirm the running worker was restarted after upgrade.

patch-available.label: VULNERABLE - PATCH NOW
patch-available.meaning: Supported branch below the fixed build. Upgrade and restart workers.

no-upstream-fix.label: VULNERABLE - NO UPSTREAM FIX
no-upstream-fix.meaning: End-of-life branch with only a backport path. Take a vendor/LTS/source backport or isolate; migrate.
